judged_text: isTeamAdminOrOwner combines isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && instead of ||, so a team admin who is not also the owner fails the check. Team admins (who per the naming should be authorized) fall through to the attendee/organizer checks; for bookings they administer but neither booked nor attend, the handler throws FORBIDDEN "you_do_not_have_permission".
